scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,api,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,blue,cyan "pnpm dev:mock" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.setup:local: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:wait: node -e "const{execSync}=require('node:child_process');for(let i=0;i<40;i++){try{execSync('docker exec hub-postgres pg_isready -U hub',{stdio:'pipe'});console.log('postgres 就绪');process.exit(0)}catch{require('node:child_process').execSync('sleep 2')}}console.error('等待超时');process.exit(1)"
